3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The door slowly opened and Pabel entered, a fluffy towel in his arms. He hung it on a hook on the wall.

4.speaker: Pabel Adria
4.text: "Your Majesty... How much have you been told about your father's death?"

8.speaker: Pabel Adria
8.text: "Listen, Rom... How much have they told you about your father's death?"

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "It was a heart attack. What else would I need to know?"

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "I haven't cared enough to go digging around."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Not a lot. Do you suspect something?"

15.speaker: Pabel Adria
15.text: "Back when my dad was still alive, he showed me every single plant in the Palas Rezna gardens."

16.speaker: Pabel Adria
16.text: "You remember my father, the groundskeeper. When I was younger, he showed me every single plant in the gardens of Palas Rezna."

17.speaker: Pabel Adria
17.text: "One of them was mandragora. Big green leaves, pretty purple flowers."

18.speaker: Pabel Adria
18.text: "He told me you can make an extract from its roots. A little bit helps you sleep. More than that causes delirium. And a lot stops your heart."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "I think I see where this is going."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "Why didn't you ever tell me about this plant?"

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "Mandragora? You've been reading too many fantasy novels."

22.speaker: Pabel Adria
22.text: "You were the royal heir. Why would you need to know about gardening?"

23.speaker: Pabel Adria
23.text: "The name sounds silly, I know. That's why it stuck in my head all these years."

24.speaker: Pabel Adria
24.text: "After he died, I went out to the part of the garden where my father had planted the mandragora. Nothing but a smooth patch of dirt."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "When was the last time you saw the plants?"

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "Who was around the palace that night?"

27.speaker: Pabel Adria
27.text: "There were only a few people King Valero trusted by the end. If my suspicions are correct, it means one of them took advantage of that trust."

29.speaker: Pabel Adria
29.text: "And all of those people are still in your inner circle today."

33.speaker: Pabel Adria
33.text: "I only spoke to you when I was spoken to, Your Majesty."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "Is there another reason you wanted to come in?"

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: I noticed an identical towel on the hook next to it.

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: He took a step closer to the tub, conscientiously keeping his eyes on the wall.

39.speaker: Pabel Adria
39.text: "Actually, there was something I wanted to bring up. Without any guards around."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "Why? Don't you trust the Golden Guard?"

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "I'd really rather not have company in here, Pabel. Save the talk for another day."

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: He backed out the door, bowing slightly as he did so.

46.speaker: Pabel Adria
46.text: "I don't know whom I can trust, to be honest."

47.speaker: Pabel Adria
47.text: "It might be. Or it might not be. I'm not sure."

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: There was a small stool next to the tub. He moved over to it and sat with his back to me.

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "Well? What did you want to tell me?"

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: Pabel turned around, still taking care to look only at my face. He spoke the next words slowly.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: Pabel spoke the next words slowly.

58.speaker: Pabel Adria
58.text: "When I attended to your father on his sickbed, he didn't seem like a man suffering from heart failure. He was in a complete daze, as if he didn't even recognize me."

59.speaker: Pabel Adria
59.text: "A few months before that, maybe. I remembered the flowers blooming."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "Could someone have slipped it in his supper?"

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "I've heard enough. It sounds like his paranoia was rubbing off on you."
61.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Coroner"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Supper"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Suspects"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Plants"] == true

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "All right. Let's say Father was indeed poisoned. What would be the motivation?"
62.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Coroner"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Supper"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Suspects"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Plants"] == true

63.speaker: Pabel Adria
63.text: "The Queen Mother, obviously. Grand Wiseman Ignacius. Titus and his men..."

66.speaker: Pabel Adria
66.text: "I was tasting all of His Majesty's food at that time. So whoever it was would have had to be very creative."

67.speaker: Pabel Adria
67.text: "So yes, it's possible their disappearance had nothing to do with the King's death."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "If he was poisoned, the coroner would have caught it."

70.speaker: Pabel Adria
70.text: "Mandragora is a naturally occurring substance. It may not have raised a flag."

89.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
89.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Coroner"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Supper"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Suspects"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Plants"] == true

90.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
90.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Coroner"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Supper"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Suspects"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_ValeroPoisonQs_Plants"] == true) == false

91.speaker: Pabel Adria
91.text: "We both know His Majesty had a long list of enemies."

92.speaker: Pabel Adria
92.text: "But the goal could simply have been to put you on the throne."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "So I have a secret friend in the palace."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "Nobody wanted me to be King that badly."

96.speaker: Pabel Adria
96.text: "But please, look out for yourself nonetheless."

97.speaker: Pabel Adria
97.text: "No matter what, I would urge you to look out for yourself."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "I see. I'm going to have to look into this further." [Potential Investigation]

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Even if you're right, this isn't worth pursuing. Nobody's going to murder me."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "I'm not seeing it, Pabel. It's too fantastical."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "Wait. What if *you* did it and you're trying to throw me off your trail?"

102.speaker: Pabel Adria
102.text: "Of course. I would never hide anything from you. You and I go too far back for that."

106.speaker: Pabel Adria
106.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. Your well-being is of the utmost importance to me."

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: Pabel drew his breath in through his teeth.

112.speaker: Pabel Adria
112.text: "It's indeed a stretch, Your Majesty. Please forget I broached the subject, then."

113.speaker: Pabel Adria
113.text: "You're right, Romus. Forget I even brought it up."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: 'I *know* I'm right. Who would possibly want to kill me?"

120.speaker: Pabel Adria
120.text: "I can assure you of my innocence, Your Majesty."

121.speaker: Pabel Adria
121.text: "Why would I even be telling you all this, then?"

125.speaker: Pabel Adria
125.text: "We may not be the close confidantes we once were, but I'll always have your back."

129.speaker: Pabel Adria
129.text: "Trust me, old friend. I'll always have your back."

133.speaker: Pabel Adria
133.text: "Yes, you tormented me in childhood. But as the royal butler, it's my job to have your back."

134.speaker: Pabel Adria
134.text: "I am the royal butler. It's my job to have your back."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Speaking of backs, can you give mine a scrub while you're here?"

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "I was your superior. As I am now. Don't try to rise above your station."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "If you've said all you have to say, you're dismissed."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "Thank you for bringing it up with me regardless, though."

142.speaker: Pabel Adria
142.text: "I was only looking out for your own well-being."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "Thanks for bringing it to my attention."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "What do you think I should do next?"

146.speaker: Pabel Adria
146.text: "I wish I knew. Try to find out as much as you can without raising suspicion, I guess."

148.speaker: Pabel Adria
148.text: "I'll keep an ear out myself. Palace gossip gets around."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "I'm sorry about that. I didn't know any better."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Remember I'm still your superior. Don't try to rise above your station."

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: A pained expression flashed across his face.

154.speaker: Pabel Adria
154.text: "I would never presume to do that, Your Majesty."

155.speaker: Pabel Adria
155.text: "I'll take my leave now. I hope the water is still warm."

162.speaker: Pabel Adria
162.text: "No, that's everything. I'll take my leave before the bathwater gets cold."

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: He took a warm, soapy washcloth and carefully ran it over my back and shoulders. I felt the day's tension leaving my body.

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: He took a warm, soapy washcloth and scrubbed my back in a businesslike manner.

170.speaker: Pabel Adria
170.text: "I'll take my leave before your water gets too cold."

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: He quietly exited the room, leaving me to finish my bath.

173.speaker: Pabel Adria
173.text: "That's everything, Your Majesty. I hope your bathwater is still warm."

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: He finished the phrase with a gentle smile, then rose from his seat.

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "Stay and chat? Baths are boring alone."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "I'm happy there's one member of my inner circle I can trust."

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: He bowed his head in gratitude and quietly exited, leaving me to finish my bath.

189.speaker: Narrator
189.text: He sat down. We kept talking as I finished my bath.

193.speaker: Pabel Adria
193.text: "You're the king, Romus. You can't lift a finger without making an enemy of someone somewhere."

194.speaker: Pabel Adria
194.text: "I beg your pardon, Your Majesty, but you're the king. Enemies come with the territory."

197.speaker: Pabel Adria
197.text: "Lucita Azaro was also in town, meeting with your uncle to discuss the interim security councilor position."
